features.title: Account pool identity and bulk operations
features.summary: Retain account classification, scoped priority and safe refresh/export UX.
invariants: Bulk operations resolve a fixed structured scope; priorities update only intended accounts.
Retain credential boundaries, stable identity and manual refresh result ownership.

features.title: Quota model and late result isolation
features.summary: Retain provider quota semantics and session-revision protection.
invariants: Provider identity, paid/free classes and reset instants retain their recorded meanings.
Connection/base/key/auth revision changes suppress stale success/error/state effects.

features.title: Plugin source and OAuth ownership
features.summary: Keep plugin source awareness and cancelled discovery/import semantics.
invariants: Same plugin ID from different sources remains distinguishable.
Disabled providers cannot shadow enabled routes; stale OAuth/quota discovery cannot publish results.

dependencies.contract: Resolve codex-invite by registry/source and version, not ID alone; consume the public fork registry and archive.

features.title: Single-file management asset and configuration
features.summary: Preserve static delivery, hash routing, config API and locale contracts.
invariants: Publish exactly management.html as the single inlined asset; retain hash routing/version injection.
Use v8 application API; compose locale trees without losing fork keys.

dependencies.contract: The management.html artifact and v8 config/auth/OAuth/plugin contracts must match the paired CPA candidate.
